description:
Welcome to a comprehensive, in-depth breakdown of a heated and intellectually rigorous foreign policy debate from the Keeping It Real Podcast with Jillian Michaels. In this featured episode, health and wellness expert turned media host Jillian Michaels sits down with progressive political commentator and radio host Sam Seder for a sprawling, high-stakes conversation. Rather than sticking exclusively to domestic issues, the dialogue dives headfirst into complex global affairs, international law, superpower diplomacy, and the ethical weight of military intervention.

 

The first major battleground of the debate centers on European security architecture and the historical trajectory of NATO expansion. The participants debate the geopolitical dynamics leading up to the conflict in Eastern Europe, analyzing post-Cold War diplomatic assurances, historical understandings, and the principles enshrined in the 1994 Budapest Memorandum. One side argues that continuous alliance expansion crossed established diplomatic red lines, while the other maintains that sovereign independent nations possess an inherent right to seek collective security against regional intimidation. This segment examines whether historical offramps were mishandled and how international agreements shape the modern security landscape.

 

As the conversation transitions to the Middle East, the debate pivots toward Iran's nuclear enrichment program, deterrence theory, and regional stability. The speakers cross swords
